messages:
dmitri: quick heads-up — measured a p95 regression ~15% on mixtral-awq-int8 after yesterday's AWQ calibration roll. metrics + traces below.

alice: which test/bench? perf lab or canary?

dmitri: synthetic qps profile on perf-rig (batch=8, seq=1024). baseline (pre-calib) vs post: 
```
baseline: p95=48ms, p50=12ms, thpt=210 tok/s
post-calib: p95=55ms, p50=13ms, thpt=205 tok/s
delta p95 = +14.6%
```

ben: interesting. any kernel fallback logs? maybe int8 kernel selection changed. :thinking_face: 

dmitri: trace shows spikes of fallback to fp16_gemm around layers 16-20. snippet: 
```
kernel_select: awq_int8 -> awq_int8_kv; fallback at layer 18 due to overflow check
kv_prefetch: enabled, window=4
rope_scale: 1.15 applied for mixtral head correction
```

carla: rope_scale change + kv prefetch eviction could interact. saw eviction churn on layers 16-20.

alice: can you run profile with kv_prefetch=off and rope_scale=1.0 to isolate?

dmitri: ran quick: kv_prefetch=off -> p95 back to 49ms. rope_scale=1.0 alone -> p95=52ms. so prefetch seems primary.

ben: probable cause: AWQ calibration changed per-head kv dims causing cache line misalignment, more cache misses and kernel fallbacks. batcher scheduling may also be affected if small KV hits get evicted.

carla: let's try align_kv_stride=true + smaller prefetch window. small experiment?

dmitri: applying on perf-rig and instrumenting kernel selector to emit layer-level heuristics. patch: 
```
runtime.config:
  awq_mode: calibrated
  align_kv_stride: true
  kv_prefetch.window: 2
  kernel.selector.debug: layers
```

infra-bot: deploy started to perf-rig-07 (dmitri/shot). ETA ~2m. :gear:

dmitri: results: p95=50ms, p50=12ms, thpt=208 tok/s. improvement vs post-calib but still +4% vs baseline.

alice: ok that suggests align + smaller window helps. next: update kernel selector to prefer awq_int8_kv when align_kv_stride=true and add heuristic to reduce prefetch window for models with rope_scale != 1.0.

ben: I'll open a quick PR for kernel selector heuristic + unit test. assigning to @ben.

carla: add a regression alert suppression so hosted telemetry doesn't auto-page until we have canary.

dmitri: noted. action items: ben PR, infra to run canary on dedicated, add per-layer k_fallback counter to monitoring. tagging @observability.

infra-bot: perf-run scheduled for canary pool in 30m.

alice: thanks all — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
